chem.q: On heating, 50g of calcium carbonate (CaCO&sub3;) decomposes completely into CaO and CO&sub2;. The mass of CaO produced is (molar masses: CaCO&sub3;=100, CaO=56):
chem.e: Moles of CaCO&sub3; = 50/100 = 0.5. CaCO&sub3; → CaO + CO&sub2; (1:1 ratio). Mass of CaO = 0.5 × 56 = 28g.

bio.q: In human beings, the process of digestion of starch begins in the mouth due to the enzyme:
bio.e: Salivary amylase (ptyalin), present in saliva, begins the breakdown of starch into maltose in the mouth.
